caption: Multipath: the direct and reflected signals arrive together at the mobile receiver, adding when in phase and canceling when out of phase — so a moving car hears the rapid flutter called picket fencing.
spoken: This figure shows one signal reaching a moving car over two paths, one direct and one reflected off a building. Where the two arrive in phase the signal is stronger; where they arrive out of phase it nearly cancels, so a moving car hears a rapid flutter called picket fencing.
